world: M MULTIPLICATIVE -- NOT REFUTED at a resolution of 0.27, not established
outcome_variable_scope: r30's source-specificity share, rebuilt exactly from r22's per-prompt own/near/random cells. No judge is run, no response generated, no GPU used.
scope: Two donor conditions, three judges, 300 prompts. Inherits r30's gap that no phi cell was measured at the farthest-donor floor. Three judges cannot characterise judge families in general -- this settles whether THESE three are related by a pure gain, which is what r95 left open.
verdict: M MULTIPLICATIVE -- NOT REFUTED at a resolution of 0.27, not established. r95 left this UNVERIFIED, said the paired ratio needed joint draws r30 discarded, and named a GPU re-score of r80's frozen panel as the fix. THE ARTIFACT WAS ALREADY ON DISK: r22 persisted per-prompt own/near/random cells for all three judges over the same 300 prompts, in a 17 KB file. The joint structure was never discarded -- it was written by a different round, and asking the filesystem cost one `find`. RESOLVED: the near/random ratio is 0.5394 [0.1392,1.0727], 0.5671 [0.3761,0.7994], 0.7354 [0.5298,0.9893], a 1.36x point spread, and paired on the same draws every pairwise difference straddles zero: phi-3.5-mini-instruct - qwen2.5-3b-instruct = -0.0168 [-0.4233,+0.4737]; phi-3.5-mini-instruct - qwen3.5-2b-base(ref) = -0.1875 [-0.6055,+0.2956]; qwen2.5-3b-instruct - qwen3.5-2b-base(ref) = -0.1706 [-0.4229,+0.0657]. THE NON-REJECTION MUST BE READ AGAINST WHAT THIS TEST CAN RESOLVE, WHICH THE PLANT FIXES: it detects a ratio difference of 0.270 while the largest observed difference is 0.187 -- BELOW its own demonstrated threshold. So the multiplicative model is NOT REFUTED rather than established, and the 1.36x point spread is neither confirmed real nor shown to be noise. SO THE JUDGE IS NOT DISTINGUISHABLE FROM A PURE GAIN at this resolution, and layer-at-a-time validation of R is not shown to fail for cardinal claims either -- which upgrades r95 from UNVERIFIED to a BOUNDED non-rejection, weaker than separability established. THREE CONTROLS, EACH ABLE TO VOID THE ROUND. REBUILD: r22's cells reproduce r30's six stored shares to 0e+00, so these are r30's cells and not a lookalike. GAIN-INVARIANCE, a NEGATIVE control: scaling one judge's deviations from chance by 3.7x moves its ratio by 4e-15 -- the statistic is blind to pure scale, which is what makes it a test of interaction rather than of magnitude. PLANT, a POSITIVE control: a judge constructed with ratio 0.2697 against 0.5394 is detected at -0.2772 [-0.5363,-0.0696], so a null here would be a measurement and not an instrument that never fires; the round refuses to run otherwise. SCOPE: this covers the near and random donor conditions on 300 prompts with three judges. It inherits r30's own gap -- no phi cell exists at the farthest-donor floor -- and three judges cannot speak for judge families in general.
